description: This image helps the reader understand that the innermost complex zeros of the reliability polynomial of K_n sit at distance about (2 log n − 1.392)/n inside the unit circle, in two mirror-image directions at about ±137 degrees rather than on the negative real axis.
head: Reliability zeros of K_n
sub: Innermost zeros: distance (2 log n − 1.392)/n inside the unit circle, at about ±137 degrees; the constant comes from Waldvogel's W_0 = 0.7377…
